rule: Skill-primer drills are prescribed as 4 sets (with 3 reps, up to 2 skills, about 10-12 min)
summary: No study sets the number of technique sets. 4 x 3 per drill (about 24 quality reps across 2 skills) is set by the 10-12 min time budget, not by data. The spacing review supports small, frequent doses over big ones, and the cluster-set studies support keeping each set short; neither tests 4 sets. Keep it as a time-boxed heuristic, and let 'stop when mechanics degrade' cut sets short.

sources.note: Cecilio-Fernandes 2018: spaced practice beats massed practice for retention, which supports small frequent doses, not a specific set count
Hardee 2013: technique degraded across sets 1-3 of continuous power cleans; short sets and rests protect it
